editorialSummary.heading: Student holidays and campus calendar differences
highlights: A Wednesday, August 12 start and Wednesday, May 26 finish
Thirteen no-school weekdays from December 18 through January 5
Separate ACE ADSY and Third Future Schools calendars for six campuses
paragraphs: The regular San Antonio ISD calendar runs from Aug. 12, 2026 through May 26, 2027. Student holidays for staff professional development include Sep. 18, Oct. 9, Nov. 6 and Feb. 5. Parent-teacher conference days on Oct. 23 and Feb. 12 are also no-school days for students.

Students are off Oct. 9-12, with staff professional development on Oct. 9 and the Columbus/Indigenous People's Day holiday on Oct. 12. Winter break runs Dec. 18-Jan. 1, followed by teacher planning on Jan. 4 and professional development on Jan. 5; students return Jan. 6. Feb. 15 and Mar. 29 are also reserved as bad-weather make-up days, so either long weekend could be shortened if SAISD activates a make-up day.

Hot Wells Middle School, Poe Middle School and Crockett Academy use the ACE Resource ADSY calendar. Tafolla Middle School, Hirsch Elementary and Ogden Elementary use the Third Future Schools calendar. Those calendars have different attendance dates from the regular district calendar.

faqs.question: When is the first day of school for San Antonio ISD in 2026-2027?
faqs.answer: The first student day on the regular district calendar is Wednesday, August 12, 2026.

faqs.question: When is the last day of school in 2027?
faqs.answer: On the regular district calendar, students finish Wednesday, May 26, 2027, which also closes the fourth grading period.

faqs.question: Which campuses use a different calendar?
faqs.answer: Hot Wells Middle School, Poe Middle School, and Crockett Academy use the ACE ADSY calendar. Tafolla Middle School, Hirsch Elementary, and Ogden Elementary use the Third Future Schools calendar.

faqs.question: Does San Antonio ISD have a fall break in October 2026?
faqs.answer: The regular district calendar does not label a separate Fall Break. Students are off October 9 for staff professional development and October 12 for a holiday, creating a four-day weekend from October 9-12. Classes resume Tuesday, October 13.

faqs.question: Is there school on October 12, 2026?
faqs.answer: No. San Antonio ISD lists October 12 as Columbus/Indigenous People's Day with no school on the regular calendar. ACE and Third Future calendars also list a holiday that day.

faqs.question: Are students off October 23 for parent-teacher conferences?
faqs.answer: Yes. On the regular district calendar, Friday, October 23, 2026, is a student holiday while parent-teacher conferences are scheduled. ACE students attend an ADSY half-day that day.

faqs.question: When is Thanksgiving Break in 2026?
faqs.answer: Thanksgiving Break runs Monday, November 23, through Friday, November 27. Classes resume November 30.

faqs.question: When is San Antonio ISD Winter Break in 2026-2027?
faqs.answer: On the regular district calendar, Winter Break runs December 18, 2026, through January 1, 2027.

faqs.question: When do students return after winter break?
faqs.answer: On the regular district calendar, classes resume Wednesday, January 6, 2027. January 4 is a student holiday for teacher planning, and January 5 is a student holiday for staff professional development.

faqs.question: Are students off January 4 and 5, 2027?
faqs.answer: Yes. On the regular district calendar, January 4 is a student holiday for teacher planning and January 5 is a student holiday for staff professional development. Classes resume January 6. ACE students attend a half-day January 4 and a full day January 5.

faqs.question: Is Martin Luther King Jr. Day a school holiday?
faqs.answer: Yes. Students on the regular San Antonio ISD calendar do not attend classes on Monday, January 18, 2027.

faqs.question: Is there school on February 5, 2027?
faqs.answer: No, on the regular district calendar. February 5 is a student holiday for staff professional development. ACE campuses follow a different schedule that day.

faqs.question: Are students off February 12 and 15, 2027?
faqs.answer: On the regular district calendar, February 12 is a student holiday for parent-teacher conferences. February 15 is a holiday also marked as a Bad Weather Makeup Day, so it is not a guaranteed day off. If that make-up day is not activated, students return February 16.

faqs.question: When is San Antonio ISD Spring Break in 2027?
faqs.answer: On the regular district calendar, Spring Break is March 8-12, 2027. Students return Monday, March 15.

faqs.question: Are students off March 26 and March 29, 2027?
faqs.answer: On the regular district calendar, March 26 is a holiday. March 29 is a student holiday for teacher planning and is also marked as a Bad Weather Makeup Day. If the make-up day is not activated, students return Tuesday, March 30; otherwise, they attend March 29.

faqs.question: Is there school on April 23, 2027?
faqs.answer: No. The regular San Antonio ISD calendar marks Friday, April 23, 2027, as a school holiday.

faqs.question: When do the four grading periods end?
faqs.answer: On the regular district calendar, the grading periods end October 8, December 17, March 5, and May 26.

faqs.question: Does the regular calendar list any early-release days?
faqs.answer: No. The regular 2026-2027 calendar does not identify an early-release or half-day schedule for students.

faqs.question: Is May 27, 2027 a school day?
faqs.answer: No, on the regular district calendar. May 26 is the last student day; May 27 is a teacher-planning day after students finish. Third Future Schools use a different calendar.

faqs.question: Where can I download the official San Antonio ISD 2026-2027 calendar?
faqs.answer: Use the official PDF link on this page or visit San Antonio ISD’s instructional-calendars page for the current version.

faqs.question: Can the calendar change after publication?
faqs.answer: Yes. Families should follow district and campus messages for weather closures, make-up instruction, or later revisions.

editorialSummary.heading: How the ACE Resource ADSY calendar differs
highlights: 181 total student learning days including ADSY
Five designated student full days and six ADSY half-days
Campus scope limited to Hot Wells MS, Poe MS, and Crockett Academy
paragraphs: The ACE Resource ADSY calendar keeps the same August 12 first day, May 26 last day, and grading-period boundaries as the regular San Antonio ISD calendar. Its attendance pattern is different. September 18, October 9, November 6, January 5, and February 5 are marked as student full days instead of student holidays.

The official winter break runs through Jan. 1. Students next attend Monday, Jan. 4 for an ADSY half-day, followed by a full student day Jan. 5. Other half-days are Oct. 23, Jan. 23, Feb. 12, Mar. 29 and Apr. 3; Jan. 23 and Apr. 3 are Saturdays. The calendar does not list half-day dismissal times.

Feb. 15 is a holiday also reserved for bad-weather make-up instruction. Students may attend if the date is activated. Unlike students on the regular district calendar, ACE students attend an ADSY half-day on Mar. 29. The date also carries the bad-weather make-up designation.

faqs.answer: The PDF applies to Hot Wells Middle School, Poe Middle School, and Crockett Academy only.

faqs.question: What does ACE mean in San Antonio ISD?
faqs.answer: ACE stands for Accelerating Campus Excellence. San Antonio ISD introduced the model at Poe Middle School, Hot Wells Middle School and Crockett Academy for 2026-2027.

faqs.question: When does the ACE 2026-2027 school year start and end?
faqs.answer: ACE students begin Wednesday, August 12, 2026, and finish Wednesday, May 26, 2027.

faqs.question: How many student learning days are on the ACE calendar?
faqs.answer: The calendar lists 181 total student learning days, including the designated ADSY days.

faqs.question: Which dates are ACE student full days?
faqs.answer: The five full days are September 18, October 9, November 6, January 5, and February 5.

faqs.question: What are the six ACE ADSY half-day dates?
faqs.answer: Half-days fall October 23, January 4, January 23, February 12, March 29, and April 3.

faqs.question: Are any ACE ADSY half-days on Saturdays?
faqs.answer: Yes. January 23 and April 3, 2027, are Saturday ADSY half-days.

faqs.question: What time do ACE students leave on half-days?
faqs.answer: The PDF does not list dismissal times. Families should confirm the schedule directly with their campus.

faqs.question: Is October 9, 2026 a holiday for ACE students?
faqs.answer: No. October 9 is marked as a student full day on the ACE calendar; October 12 is the holiday.

faqs.question: When is ACE Thanksgiving Break in 2026?
faqs.answer: Students are off November 23-27 and return to class Monday, November 30.

faqs.question: When is ACE Winter Break in 2026-2027?
faqs.answer: ACE Winter Break runs December 18, 2026, through January 1, 2027.

faqs.question: When do ACE students return after winter break?
faqs.answer: ACE students next attend Monday, January 4, 2027, for an ADSY half-day; January 5 is a full student day.

faqs.question: Are February 12 and February 15, 2027 holidays for ACE students?
faqs.answer: February 12 is an ADSY half-day. February 15 is a holiday also marked as a Bad Weather Makeup Day, so it is not a guaranteed day off.

faqs.question: When is Spring Break for ACE students in 2027?
faqs.answer: Spring Break runs March 8-12, 2027, with classes resuming Monday, March 15.

faqs.question: Do ACE students attend on March 29, 2027?
faqs.answer: Yes. March 29 is an ADSY half-day, not a full student holiday. The date also carries the bad-weather make-up designation.

faqs.question: Do Hot Wells, Poe and Crockett follow the regular district calendar?
faqs.answer: No. These three campuses use the ACE Resource ADSY calendar, with additional full days and half-days. San Antonio ISD publishes the regular district calendar separately.

highlights: An August 4 start, eight days before the regular SAISD calendar
184 student-teacher contact days across four quarters
June 2-4 reserved as possible make-up days
paragraphs: Tafolla Middle School, Hirsch Elementary, and Ogden Elementary follow the Third Future Schools calendar instead of San Antonio ISD’s regular instructional calendar. Students begin Tuesday, August 4, 2026. The calendar contains 184 contact days, with quarter totals of 47, 43, 46, and 48 days. A fifth-quarter summer session from June 22 through July 17, 2026, is voluntary for some students and mandatory for others.

Staff development on Sep. 4 precedes Labor Day on Sep. 7. In October, staff development on Oct. 9 is followed by Columbus Day on Oct. 12 and parent-teacher conferences Oct. 13-14; students return Oct. 15. Conferences Feb. 10-11, staff development Feb. 12 and Presidents' Day Feb. 15 create another break, with classes resuming Feb. 16.

Field trips are scheduled May 17-21, and May 26-27 are parent-teacher conference days with no classes. May 28 is the last day listed if no make-up days are needed. June 2-4 are possible make-up dates, subject to activation.

faqs.answer: The calendar lists Friday, May 28, 2027, as the last day if no make-up days are needed. June 2-4 remain possible make-up dates.

faqs.question: Could Third Future students have school in June 2027?
faqs.answer: Yes. June 2-4 are possible make-up days, but they become attendance days only if activated.

faqs.question: How many contact days are in each Third Future Schools quarter?
faqs.answer: The four quarters contain 47, 43, 46, and 48 contact days, respectively.

editorialSummary.heading: Student holidays, make-up dates and 2027-2028 breaks
highlights: A Wednesday, August 11 start and Wednesday, May 24 finish
Winter time off continues from December 17 through January 4
March 13 is a planning day also reserved for possible bad-weather make-up instruction
paragraphs: The regular 2027-2028 San Antonio ISD calendar starts Aug. 11, 2027 and ends May 24, 2028. Student holidays tied to staff professional development include Sep. 17, Oct. 8, Nov. 5, Jan. 4 and Feb. 4. Jan. 3 is a teacher-planning day with no classes for students, while Oct. 22 and Feb. 18 are no-school parent-teacher conference days.

Students are off Oct. 8-11 across a long weekend. Winter break runs Dec. 17-31, followed by teacher planning Jan. 3 and professional development Jan. 4; classes resume Jan. 5. Spring Break is Mar. 6-10. Feb. 21 and Mar. 13 are also marked as bad-weather make-up dates, so neither should be treated as a guaranteed day off. Without activation, students return from spring break Mar. 14.

about.dataSource: This page uses San Antonio ISD’s official 2027-2028 Instructional Calendar, version 2 dated January 30, 2026, plus the district’s instructional-calendar page. The district Board Meeting Schedule supplies the named October or February holidays where the instructional PDF uses a generic holiday label.
about.processing: Events preserve the dates and attendance categories shown on the official calendar. Separate holidays, planning days and staff-development days are not merged into new events. Breaks describe longer spans away from school and reference their component events; any bad-weather make-up component remains conditional. Grading-period milestone names are normalized from official boundaries. The noSchoolDayEventIds index contains confirmed no-class or no-student events and excludes conditional make-up dates. Conditional attendance is a normalized interpretation of official make-up designations; the event basis and source labels retain the official evidence.
about.updates: Use the calendar assigned to your campus. The regular calendar marks two dates for possible bad-weather make-up instruction; district announcements determine whether students attend. Check the instructional-calendars page for revisions.
about.disclaimer: This independent reference is not operated by San Antonio ISD. Confirm transportation, meals, conferences, campus events, weather changes, and any revised calendar with the district or your child’s school.

faqs.question: When does San Antonio ISD start school in 2027-2028?
faqs.answer: The first student day on the regular district calendar is Wednesday, August 11, 2027.

faqs.question: When is the last day of school in 2028?
faqs.answer: The last student day on the regular district calendar is Wednesday, May 24, 2028.

faqs.question: Is there school on September 17, 2027?
faqs.answer: No. September 17 is a student holiday while staff professional development is scheduled.

faqs.question: Does San Antonio ISD have a fall break in October 2027?
faqs.answer: The regular district calendar does not label a separate Fall Break. Students are off October 8 for staff professional development and October 11 for a holiday, creating a four-day weekend from October 8-11. Classes resume Tuesday, October 12.

faqs.question: When are fall parent-teacher conferences in 2027?
faqs.answer: Friday, October 22, is a student holiday while parent-teacher conferences are held.

faqs.question: When is Thanksgiving Break in 2027?
faqs.answer: Thanksgiving Break runs November 22-26, with classes resuming Monday, November 29.

faqs.question: When is San Antonio ISD Winter Break in 2027-2028?
faqs.answer: On the regular district calendar, Winter Break runs December 17-31, 2027.

faqs.question: When do students return after winter break?
faqs.answer: On the regular district calendar, classes resume Wednesday, January 5, 2028. January 3 is a teacher-planning student holiday and January 4 is a staff professional-development student holiday.

faqs.question: Is December 17, 2027 a school day?
faqs.answer: No. December 17 is marked as a holiday on the regular calendar, although the semester notes list the first semester through that date. The second grading period ends December 16; students return January 5.

faqs.question: Is there school on February 4, 2028?
faqs.answer: No. February 4 is a student holiday for staff professional development.

faqs.question: Are students off February 18 and 21, 2028?
faqs.answer: February 18 is a student holiday for conferences. February 21 is a holiday also marked as a Bad Weather Makeup Day. Without activation, students return February 22; district announcements determine whether February 21 becomes an attendance day.

faqs.question: When is San Antonio ISD Spring Break in 2028?
faqs.answer: Spring Break is March 6-10. March 13 is a separate teacher-planning student holiday also marked as a Bad Weather Makeup Day. If the make-up day is not activated, students return Tuesday, March 14; otherwise, they attend March 13.

faqs.question: When does the fourth grading period begin?
faqs.answer: The fourth grading period starts Tuesday, March 14, 2028. March 13 is a teacher-planning day that may be used for bad-weather make-up instruction.

faqs.question: Are April 14 and April 28, 2028 school holidays?
faqs.answer: Yes. The district calendar marks both Fridays as no-school holidays.

faqs.question: What are the grading-period dates for 2027-2028?
faqs.answer: The periods run August 11-October 7, October 12-December 16, January 5-March 3, and March 14-May 24.

faqs.question: Does the regular calendar list any early-release days?
faqs.answer: No. The 2027-2028 regular calendar does not identify an early-release or half-day date.

faqs.question: Is May 25, 2028 a school day?
faqs.answer: No. Students finish May 24; May 25 is reserved for teacher planning.
